modules.name: Card Services
modules.what_it_does: issues and services card accounts: the CA00 online dialogue (inquiry, maintenance, authorisation, fraud screens) and the CARDNITE, CARDBILL and CARDREF batch cycles over CARDDB

modules.name: Party & Risk
modules.what_it_does: maintains party KYC, sanctions/watch-list screening and credit-exposure risk scores: PRKYC/PRRSK online services reached from CA00 and the weekly PARTYWK batch over PARTYDB

shared.name: CARDCHK
shared.why: HLASM subroutine INCLUDEd statically by the COBCICS and COBBATCH link-edit steps, which BUILDALL uses for both modules; CSD-defined in CARDGRP. Only its names are known: mftb has no assembler analyser (catalog-assembler ask), and no scanned COBOL source CALLs it by literal

shared.name: CARDXREF
shared.why: group CARDFILE defines the region FCTs for both CARD.PROD.* and PRTY.PROD.* (RSKPARM, WATCHLST) datasets in the one CICSCARD region

shared.name: CSDUPCRD
shared.why: installs CARDFILE/CARDMAP/CARDTDQ/CARDGRP and PRTYGRP into the single CARDLIST group list of region CICSCARD

shared.name: CVCONSTY
shared.why: estate copybook library (README.md:15) copied by programs of both modules

shared.name: CVERRS01Y

shared.name: CVRISK01Y

shared.name: BUILDALL
shared.why: full estate rebuild: compiles CARDSVC (ONL/OND/BAT/BDY steps) and PARTYRSK (PRO/PRB steps)

shared.name: COBBATCH
shared.why: batch compile/link PROC used by BUILDALL for both CARDSVC and PARTYRSK batch programs

shared.name: COBCICS
shared.why: CICS compile/link PROC used by BUILDALL for both CARDSVC and PARTYRSK online programs

shared.name: 20_INDEXES
shared.why: CREATE INDEX for both CARDSVC.* and PARTYRSK.* tables in one member

shared.name: 50_GRANTS
shared.why: grants for both collections and schemas, including the legacy cross-database grants of CARDSVC.ACCOUNT/CARD_LIMIT to PRTYONL/PRTYBAT
